profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I love to build! Anywhere from back-end infrastructure to machine learning pipelines.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Researching in the field of high-dimensional data analysis, computer vision, and optimization. I am currently focused on applications of generative models and deep learning algorithms. In particular:

• Researched modern deep learning and non-convex optimization problems for practical computer vision applications.
• Created novel, compact deep learning model for detecting cancer(anomalies) in lung CT scans using Generative Adversarial Networks with Tensorflow.
• Reduced microscope scan times from 60-70 hours to 5 hours with similar accuracy using compressed sensing and non-convex optimization.

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

positions.title: Technical Staff
positions.description:
• Tracked and classified multi-target scenes with a mixture of learning algorithms
(SVM, Bayesian learning models, Convolutional Neural Networks) in Java.
• Developed tools in Python to visualize failure modes of a computer vision,
missile-defense application given 1 terabyte of data.
• Co-led biweekly seminars presenting current findings and research to internal
staff members and government sponsors.
• Volunteered in outreach programs promoting STEM in K12 education

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Advanced Multimedia Processing Lab Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed algorithms and implemented software to analyze building structures with an aerial drone. Currently working with the Parrot Bebop drone and coding in C++, Python, and JS.

positions.title: Prof. Fuchs Research Group Assistant
positions.description: Investigating the quantum properties of single defects in zinc oxide (ZnO). I am also responsible for several engineering projects related to the experiments including the design and implementation of a high power electromagnet.

positions.title: Advanced Physics Laboratory Assistant
positions.description: Maintained laboratory equipment and assisted in experiments.

positions.title: Acoustics Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and programmed a circuit board (PCB) in C, under a Linux
environment to drive underwatertransducers at modulated frequencies.
• Developed algorithms in C and Matlab for an autonomous underwater
submarine to track acoustic pings under multi-path conditions.
